name: Tokisaka Ichito
source:
His magic is to display other people face with different expression from real expression in pocket watch. It can be used to display real expression too.

[spoiler]His specialist magic is to manipulate time from different possibility, parallel universe or timeline and using it to erase or change an event. To use this magic, his magic activity should be accepted by Tokisaka bloodline depend on how big is the scale of an event and there is a possibility that this magic will be sealed by older generation. Originally, this magic have to activated together with stabilization magic to increase the successful rate or it will go berserk.[/spoiler]
